description: Search SoundCloud, browse your tracks and followers, and create, update or delete playlists.

soundcloud_new_follower_trigger.description: Runs for each new follower in SoundCloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields avatar_url, city, country, description, discogs_name, first_name, followers_count, followings_count, full_name, urn, kind, created_at, last_modified, last_name, permalink, permalink_url, plan, playlist_count, public_favorites_count, reposts_count, track_count, uri, username, website, website_title, station_urn, subscriptions

soundcloud_new_following_trigger.description: Runs for each new following in SoundCloud. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields avatar_url, city, country, description, discogs_name, first_name, followers_count, followings_count, full_name, urn, kind, created_at, last_modified, last_name, permalink, permalink_url, plan, playlist_count, public_favorites_count, reposts_count, track_count, uri, username, website, website_title, station_urn, subscriptions

output.record: object with the fields avatar_url, city, country, description, discogs_name, first_name, followers_count, followings_count, full_name, urn, kind, created_at, last_modified, last_name, permalink, permalink_url, plan, playlist_count, public_favorites_count, reposts_count, track_count, uri, username, website, website_title, station_urn, subscriptions
